utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Please be seated. Registrar, would you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honour. This is case number IT-03-66-A, the Prosecutor versus Fatmir Limaj, Haradin Bala, and Isak Musliu.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Could I now please have the appearances for the parties. First for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: MS. MCCALL
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm Shelagh McCall. With me is Helen Brady and our case manager Kim Fischer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Ms. McCall. Next, counsel for Mr. Limaj. I understand that he's appearing by telephone hookup.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: I am, Your Honour. Karim Khan, co-counsel for Fatmir Limaj.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Counsel for Mr. Bala.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour. Gregor Guy-Smith appearing on behalf of Mr. Bala with my legal assistant Nathalie van den Berge.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Counsel for Mr. Musliu.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Your Honour. Steven Powles appearing on behalf of respondent Isak Musliu.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Powles. I understand that Mr. Limaj and Mr. Musliu, who are not currently incarcerated, are not attending the Status Conference. Would their counsel kindly confirm this for the record. Mr. Khan?

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Limaj has been spoken to pursuant to Rule 65 bis, and he is content for the proceeding to take place in his absence and with counsel representing him via telephone.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Khan. Mr. Powles.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Your Honour, yes. Mr. Musliu has similarly consented.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: However, Mr. Bala is present today, and I would like to make sure that you, Mr. Bala, can follow the proceedings. Can you hear the proceedings in a language that you understand, Mr. Bala? THE APPELLANT BALA: [Interpretation] Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you, Mr. Bala. You may be seated. This is a Status Conference called in accordance with Rule 65 bis of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence. Rule 65 bis (B) requires a Status Conference to be convened within 120 days of the filing of a notice of appeal. Both Mr. Bala and the Prosecution filed notices of appeal on 30 December, 2005, which was slightly more than 120 days ago. Mr. Limaj, Mr. Bala, and Mr. Musliu, however, have all consented to have this, the first pre-appeal Status Conference, held slightly after the 120 days deadline set out in the Rule 65 bis. I thank their counsel for communicating that consent to court staff by telephone or by e-mail. As Mr. Bala is currently detained at the UN Detention Unit, I would want to start by asking him whether there are any issues that he would like to raise at this time. Mr. Bala, do you have any issues you would like to raise now? Do you have any concerns regarding your mental or physical well-being? Mr. Bala. THE APPELLANT BALA: [Interpretation] No, Your Honour. Everything is fine as far as my health state is concerned.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Bala. You may be seated. Now I would like to ask the counsel for Mr. Limaj and then of Mr. Musliu whether there are any issues that they would like to raise through counsel. First the counsel for Mr. Limaj, Mr. Khan.

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: Your Honour, I'm obliged. On behalf of Mr. Limaj, there are no matters that need occupy the Appeals Chamber at the moment. We are grateful.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Khan. Mr. Musliu -- sorry, the counsel for Mr. Musliu, Mr. Powles.

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour. I similarly confirm on behalf of Mr. Musliu there is no matter that we would wish to raise with the Appeals Chamber at this stage.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you very much. The briefing in this case is moving along nicely. The Prosecution has filed its appellant's brief, and Mr. Limaj and Mr. Musliu have filed their respondent briefs. Mr. Bala's respondent's brief is due in the next few days. After the Prosecution files its reply, the briefing of the Prosecution's appeal will be complete. Mr. Bala's appellant's brief will also be due in the next few days. After the Prosecution response and Mr. Bala replies, the briefing of that appeal will be complete. The Appeals Chamber will, of course, try to read through the briefs and schedule oral arguments on the appeals as soon as possible. Before concluding this Status Conference, I would want to ask counsel for the Prosecution and the Defence whether they have any other issues that they would like to raise at this time. The Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MS. MCCALL
utterances.text: There's nothing to be raised Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. The Defence? I understand, Mr. Khan, that you have nothing to raise?

utterances.speaker: MR. KHAN
utterances.text: No, Your Honour. I'm grateful once again.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. GUY-SMITH
utterances.text: Yes, on behalf of Mr. Bala, considering the recent past events in his family's life, both I as well as Mr. Bala would like to thank not only the Prosecution but the Appeals Chamber for expeditedly and compassionately taking care of that matter.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Thank you. Thank you. I appreciate your comment. Mr. Powles, do you have anything?

utterances.speaker: MR. POWLES
utterances.text: No, Your Honour, nothing to raise at this stage. I'm grateful.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MERON
utterances.text: Before we adjourn, there is one last piece of business that I would like to take care of. We seem to have had a bit of difficulty scheduling this Status Conference, and I want to avoid similar scheduling problems in the future. In accordance with Rule 65 bis, we will need to have another Status Conference on or before September 1. I would like to suggest Tuesday, 29 of August, as a suitable day for our next Status Conference. So I would like everybody to plan on having a Status Conference on that day. Later in the summer, I will hopefully send out an order confirming that the Status Conference will be held on that date. The order will also let everybody know the time of the conference and the courtroom in which it will held. So I thank the parties for their attendance today and call the proceedings to a close. Thank you very much.
